q: What CBAM figure does an EU buyer need for steel from the Annaba blast furnace works?
title: Annaba blast furnace steel: the CBAM figure
short: Blast furnace steel carries coke, sinter and furnace emissions, so its figure is high, often around twice that of gas DRI steel. Ask the works for a verified figure per tonne of product. If output was intermittent, make sure the period matches your shipment.
audience: EU importers and traders buying flat and long steel from the Annaba integrated works

ul: Bought coke, pig iron or slabs as precursors.

p: Restarts burn extra fuel per tonne. A figure from a short run may not fit a full year, so ask for the period behind it.
The importer must use EU default values, which are set high on purpose. Measured data almost always helps.

senseible: Senseible keeps each site's fuel, power and production records together, so the embedded emissions you send an EU importer trace back to dated documents.
